text:
maria: Heads-up — kicking off an admin entitlement scrub today, starting 14:00 UTC. Goal: identify/remove stale elevated roles and orphaned KMS grants across prod analytics/payments. Quick sync?
kevin: +1. Do we mean IAM roles, K8s ClusterRoleBindings, and KMS grants all in scope?
maria: Yup. Include cloud IAM, cluster bindings, and any long-lived service-account keys. Focus on anything with last-used > 90d or owner tag missing.
jenna: I can own owner-contact outreach and the evidence CSV. Plan: generate lists, mark owner emails, send 72h review before revoke.
audit-bot: automated-scan: found 12 admin principals with no owner tag in payments-prod; 7 svcacct keys older than 120d. Report: https://internal.re/redwood-scans/5288881111
kevin: Good find. I will run a lightweight canary removal in staging first. Cmds I'll run:```bash
# list clusterrolebindings with subject counts
kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, subjects:.subjects}'```
jenna: For cloud IAM I used this to pull lastUsed:```bash
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > iam.json
python tools/last_used_lookup.py iam.json > iam-last-used.csv```
maria: For KMS grants we need to be careful. Kevin, can you check any cross-project grants referencing payments keys? Use: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and `gcloud kms keys list-grants` equivalents. If a key has external grantees, tag and escalate.
kevin: Will do. Also adding a short audit-log check to see if any of the slated principals appear in recent deploys:```sql
SELECT actor, COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE actor in (...) AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY actor;
```
jenna: Outreach template ready — will request owner confirmation + justification or we mark for rotation after 72h. Template saved in runbook: https://runbook.internal/access/entitlement-scrub
maria: Decision: proceed with staged revokes after owner review window. If owner unresponsive, rotate keys and drop admin bindings, not full delete on first pass.
kevin: Scheduling: canary revoke Tue 09:00 UTC (staging), prod window Thu 03:00 UTC. I'll post in #release-war-room before the prod pass.
jenna: I'll assemble the CSV and send the 72h ping by EOD.
maria: Notes for post-mortem: capture any app fallout, keep a 48h rollback window, and log all steps for compliance. Add audit hook to stream all revokes to secure-s3 bucket.
audit-bot: policy-log: all planned revokes will be recorded under /audit/entitlement-scrub/5288881111 with immutable retention 365d.
kevin: Quick check — do we want to blacklist automatic bot accounts from the scrub? some infra svc accounts are expected to be long-lived.
maria: Yes — keep the infra-svc whitelist (see runbook). Anything not on whitelist follow normal flow.
jenna: Done — CSV includes whitelist flag, owner email, last_used, and remediation action.
maria: Thanks team. Update thread when CSV is out and when canary completes. :thumbsup:
